raaga.name: Yaman
raaga.aroh: N R G M# P D N S'
raaga.avroh: S' N D P M# G R S
raaga.pakad: N R G, M#P, D N S' | S' N D P, M#G R S
raaga.chalan: N R G M#, G R S | R G M#, P D N D P, M#G R S
raaga.signatureNote: Teevra Ma (M#) is the signature swara of Raag Yaman.

learningTips.tip: Focus on the smooth glide (meend) between N-R and G-M#.
Do not touch Ma natural; only use Teevra Ma (M#).
Spend time on the Pakad and Chalan to internalize the identity of Yaman.

raaga.guruQuote: Yaman is a Raag of light and devotion. Let your Riyaz in the evening be your offering.

raaga.name: Kalyan
raaga.aroh: S R G M# P D N S'
raaga.avroh: S' N D P M# G R S
raaga.pakad: S R G M#, P D P, M#G R S
raaga.chalan: S R G M# P D N S' | S' N D P M# G R S
raaga.signatureNote: The parent-thaat raaga - a straight, sampoorna form using Teevra Ma throughout.

learningTips.tip: Keep the Aroh and Avroh perfectly straight (sampoorna both ways) before exploring Yaman's curves.

raaga.guruQuote: Kalyan is the thaat made audible in its simplest, straightest form.

raaga.name: Bhupali
raaga.aroh: S R G P D S'
raaga.avroh: S' D P G R S
raaga.pakad: G R S, R G P, G P D, P D G R S
raaga.chalan: S R G P D S' | S' D P G R S
raaga.signatureNote: An audav (pentatonic) raga using only S R G P D, ideal as a first raga for beginners.

learningTips.tip: Practice slow meend between G and P to bring out the raga's calm character.
Avoid any hint of Ma or Ni; the identity rests on the five clean swaras.

raaga.guruQuote: Simplicity of Bhupali is its greatest ornament.

raaga.name: Bhimpalasi
raaga.aroh: N. S g M P n S'
raaga.avroh: S' n D P, M P g M g R S
raaga.pakad: g M P, n D P, M P g M g R S
raaga.chalan: N. S g M P, M P n D P, M P g M g R S
raaga.varjitSwar: Re and Dha varjit in Aroh
raaga.signatureNote: Komal Gandhar and Komal Nishad give Bhimpalasi its characteristic pathos.

learningTips.tip: Approach Ni komal always from Dha, never directly.
Keep Re and Dha completely varjit in the Aroh for a clean ascent.

raaga.guruQuote: The soul of Bhimpalasi lies in its gentle andolan on Ga and Ni.

raaga.name: Kedar
raaga.aroh: S M P M D N S'
raaga.avroh: S' N D P M# P M G, M P G S
raaga.pakad: M P M G, M P D N D P M#P M G S
raaga.chalan: S M P M D N S' | S' N D P M#P M G S
raaga.signatureNote: Uses both shuddha and teevra Ma, a distinguishing feature within the Kalyan family.

learningTips.tip: Use both Ma shuddha and Ma teevra deliberately, not interchangeably.
Emphasise the Madhyam-Pancham movement that defines Kedar's grandeur.

raaga.guruQuote: Kedar carries the weight of the night in its steady Madhyam.

raaga.name: Bihag
raaga.aroh: N S G M P N S'
raaga.avroh: S' N D P M G M G R S
raaga.pakad: G M P, N S', S' N D P, M G M G R S
raaga.chalan: N S G M P N S' | S' N D P M G R S
raaga.signatureNote: The Ma-Ga-Ma-Ga oscillation gives Bihag its sweet, romantic flavour.

learningTips.tip: Practice the Ma-Ga andolan slowly before adding speed.
Keep Re and Dha out of the ascent for authentic Bihag colour.

raaga.guruQuote: Bihag's charm is in restraint, not in showing every note.

raaga.name: Desh
raaga.aroh: S R M P N S'
raaga.avroh: S' n D P M G R S
raaga.pakad: R M P, N S', S' n D P, M G R S
raaga.chalan: S R M P N S' | S' n D P M G R S
raaga.signatureNote: Both Nishad shuddha and komal are used, one going up and one coming down.

learningTips.tip: Use Ni shuddha in Aroh and Ni komal in Avroh - keep the two distinct.
Desh is closely tied to Thumri and folk idiom; let the phrasing stay light.

raaga.guruQuote: Desh sings of the monsoon and of the motherland alike.

raaga.name: Puriya Kalyan
raaga.aroh: N R G M# D N S'
raaga.avroh: S' N D M# G, M# R G R S
raaga.pakad: N R G, M#D N, D M#G, M#R G R S
raaga.chalan: N R G M#D N S' | S' N D M#G R S
raaga.signatureNote: Combines the Marwa-ang Re-Ga movement with the Kalyan-ang Ma teevra.

learningTips.tip: Avoid Pancham almost entirely to preserve the grand, Marwa-tinged mood.
The Re-Ga phrase must be sung with the same weight as in Raag Marwa.

raaga.guruQuote: Puriya Kalyan borrows Marwa's gravity and Kalyan's light in equal measure.

raaga.name: Shuddha Kalyan
raaga.aroh: S R G P D S'
raaga.avroh: S' N D P M G R S
raaga.pakad: G P D, P G, M G R S
raaga.chalan: S R G P D S' | S' N D P M G R S
raaga.varjitSwar: Ma, Ni largely avoided in Aroh
raaga.signatureNote: Essentially Bhupali's melodic body with Ma and Ni introduced lightly in the Avroh.

learningTips.tip: Introduce Ma and Ni only lightly - never let them dominate over the Bhupali skeleton.
Keep the G-P leap smooth; it is the most recognisable phrase of the raga.

raaga.guruQuote: Shuddha Kalyan is Bhupali dressed for the evening.
